page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.2xlarge is a general purpose instance in the enhanced computing family, built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. The system provides 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores of a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor with two threads per core. Memory capacity is set at 32 GB, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory profile of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware instruction extensions include AVX, AVX-512, and cryptographic accelerators like VAES and SHA-NI. The instance contains no bundled local storage disks and does not feature dedicated GPU hardware, depending entirely on network-attached storage for non-volatile persistence alongside a baseline network throughput of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluation reflects consistent mid-tier compute capabilities across synthetic and application testing. The server achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 5,386 and a PassMark CPU score of 11,285.81, showing dependable execution on compilation and cryptographic tasks. Throughput benchmarks recorded 7.95 million Redis SET operations per second and 11.32 GB/s for static web serving. Conversely, memory bandwidth for uncached large blocks registered low at 23.86 GB/s read and 23.08 GB/s write, positioning memory subsystem performance in the lower 25th percentile. This memory constraint directly affects data-heavy operations, as seen in weak token generation speeds on 7B parameter language models.

From an efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation ensures consistent compute performance without multi-tenant vCPU contention. The primary architectural tradeoff is the absence of local NVMe storage and constrained memory throughput, making this instance less viable for intensive in-memory analytics or large-model machine learning. The ecs.g7t.2xlarge is properly matched for mid-sized production web servers, containerized application runtimes, Redis caching tiers, CI/CD runners, and enterprise microservices where balanced CPU and memory allocation are prioritized over high memory bandwidth.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.2xlarge is an x86_64 general purpose virtual machine instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. Configured with 8 dedicated virtual CPUs across 4 physical cores and 32 GB of system memory, the instance delivers a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. It includes no integrated local storage and no dedicated GPU accelerators, requiring reliance on external cloud storage. Baseline network performance is rated at 5 Gbps. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate solid average performance across general integer, encryption, and decompression tasks, highlighted by 7.95 million Redis SET operations per second and 11.32 GB/s static web serving throughput. However, uncached memory bandwidth falls into the lower quartile, restricting its efficiency for large-scale memory-intensive processing and 7B LLM inference. The ecs.g7t.2xlarge is balanced for enterprise web serving, microservices, mid-tier application hosting, caching layers, and continuous integration pipelines.
